items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Cash Vaults Past $7 as Western Spike Deflates
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices surged across the Gulf Coast and Southeast Monday as air conditioning demand under an entrenched heat dome combined with recovering LNG exports to bid up hubs from Louisiana to Florida.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Edge Higher as September Reloads With More Heat
items.summary: Natural gas futures moved higher Monday as forecasts put September among the hottest on record, with recovering LNG demand and shrinking storage surpluses stacked against production running near record highs.

items.title: Europe’s Fight for LNG Puts TTF Back on the Upswing
items.summary: European natural gas prices spiked Monday as competition with Asia for LNG cargoes intensified amid renewed clashes between the United States and Iran.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Find Footing as Power Burn, LNG Stay Strong

items.title: Cheniere Completes Corpus Christi LNG Expansion Project, Exports 5,000th Cargo
items.summary: Cheniere Energy said Monday it completed its Corpus Christi LNG (CCL) Stage 3 project after bringing the seventh and final liquefaction train online at the expansion in South Texas.

items.title: Cooling Demand Slips, but Steady Heat Seen Keeping Natural Gas Storage Build Tight
items.summary: A double-digit percentage decline in cooling demand could more than double last week’s natural gas storage injection. NGI is modeling a 31 Bcf build for the week ended Aug. 28.

items.title: Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices Advance as Southwest Heat, Supply Disruptions Fuel Competition
items.summary: The physical natural gas market advanced in the final full week of August, bolstered by scorching heat across the southern reaches of the country and supply interruptions that temporarily stalled flows to the Southwest and Southern California.

items.title: LNG Canada Feedgas Demand Hits 6-Month Low Amid July Flare Repairs
items.summary: LNG Canada's Kitimat terminal drew less feedgas in July than in any month since January, with export volumes falling over the same period as crews worked through mechanical repairs, according to regulatory and Kpler data.

items.title: Is the Cheap Natural Gas Advantage for Ammonia Producers Shrinking?
items.summary: Regional natural gas basis advantages for US ammonia producers are tightening heading into the fall, tightening production margins in key markets.
